verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway natively supports authentication plugins (JWT, basic auth, OAuth2, ACLs) as documented and demoed ('adding authentication to an API in under 5 minutes'), plus mTLS and API key mechanisms are part of its plugin ecosystem, with Vaults for secure credential/secret storage. This is a core, well-documented capability corroborated across GitHub README and docs, though the specific mTLS plugin details aren't explicitly enumerated in the pack. missing for 10: explicit mTLS plugin documentation and independent third-party validation of auth plugin reliability at scale.
